target.title: fix(novita): discover live account model catalog for listing and runtime (#103532)
target.body:
## Summary

The Novita provider plugin only exposed its **static manifest catalog**, so `openclaw models list --provider novita` and runtime model resolution never saw account-available routes. This PR adds authenticated **live model discovery** (with the static catalog kept as an offline/auth-failure fallback), so account models — including the reported `novita/deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash` — are listed and registered.

Fixes #103532.

## What Problem This Solves

After configuring a Novita API key, the model selector stayed empty and a configured model like `novita/deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash` failed at runtime:

```
run error: Unknown model: novita/deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash. Found agents.defaults.models[...],
but no matching models.providers["novita"].models[] entry.
```

The shipped Novita plugin returned six fixed manifest rows and never queried the account's current catalog, so any account/region route not hard-coded in the manifest was invisible to both listing and runtime registration.

## Root Cause

- `extensions/novita/provider-catalog.ts` returned only `NOVITA_MODEL_CATALOG` (static manifest).
- Provider-filtered listing (`list.source-plan.ts`) returns those static rows before consulting a live catalog, and the runtime unknown-model path (`model.ts`) rejects any model absent from the resolved provider catalog.
- The manifest omits `deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash`, so the account-available model was never registered.

## Changes

- `extensions/novita/provider-catalog.ts`: add authenticated live discovery via the provider SDK's cached live-catalog runtime (`getCachedLiveProviderModelRows`, SSRF-guarded fetch, 5s timeout, 5min TTL cache) against the OpenAI-compatible `/models` endpoint. Rows are normalized **conservatively** — no inferred reasoning/vision/pricing or output limits, bounded model-id length and context window. The static manifest remains the fallback; a **custom Novita baseUrl suppresses discovery** so the credential is never sent to the public endpoint.
- `extensions/novita/index.ts`: wire `catalog.run` / `staticRun` and merge discovered models into `augmentModelCatalog` (runtime registration).
- `extensions/novita/index.test.ts`: regression test — mocks the SSRF-guarded fetch, asserts `deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash` is discovered for both `catalog.run` (listing) and `augmentModelCatalog` (runtime registration), and that the request carries `Authorization: Bearer <discoveryApiKey>`.
- `docs/providers/novita.md`: clarify the bundled list is the offline fallback; with an API key the current account catalog is fetched.

## Evidence

**Acceptance tests** (ClawSweeper-listed) run via CI on this branch:
- `extensions/novita/index.test.ts` — new live-discovery + runtime-registration coverage
- `src/commands/models/list.list-command.forward-compat.test.ts`, `src/commands/models/list.manifest-catalog.test.ts`
- `src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/model.test.ts`

The new test drives the **real** `buildNovitaProvider` end-to-end with only the network transport (`fetchWithSsrFGuard`) mocked, verifying the reported model flows into both the listing and runtime-registration paths with the correct auth header.

**Limitation (honest):** a fully credentialed live call (`openclaw models list --provider novita` against a real account) requires a Novita API key not available in this environment. Everything short of the real network hop is exercised; a maintainer with Novita credentials can confirm the live catalog end-to-end.

## AI-assisted

This PR was AI-assisted.
